verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform for company formation and compliance, so a public versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The only API mention is a vague 'Advanced API integrations' line on the pricing page, with no versioning scheme or deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path and no llms.txt, so there is no evidence the capability exists.
